第75章:盛京落脚，出马仙接应-《道士下山之749局》

专列一路北上，穿过平原腹地，越往北行，气温越低。

窗外的景色从江南葱郁青山，变成北方萧瑟旷野，秋风卷着枯草漫天飞舞，空气里透着一股凛冽寒意，连日光都显得黯淡无力。

经过三十六个时辰的昼夜疾驰，列车终于驶入东北盛京地界。

盛京，沈阳。

作为东北重镇，749局北方分局便隐秘设在此地，掌控整个关外灵异事件、异能者管控、邪祟镇压诸事。

专列驶入地下隐秘站台，不对外开放，不与民用铁路接轨，全程隐蔽行事，杜绝外界窥探。

列车缓缓停稳，车门开启。

八人小队依次下车，脚下是宽敞幽深的地下通道，墙壁镶嵌隐秘夜灯，光线柔和，通道两侧布有多重警戒阵法与灵气屏蔽禁制，安保严密到极致。

“这里是749局盛京地下枢纽。”林佳边走边介绍，“从这里直达地上隐秘办公区，外界看来只是一处普通老式大院，实则是北方分局核心据点。”

众人跟随着林佳，穿过长长的通道，走出地面。

映入眼帘的是一座古朴的老式四合院，青砖灰瓦，院墙高大，院内古树参天，看起来和老城区普通宅院别无二致，丝毫没有特殊部门的张扬气派。

可众人神识一扫，便能察觉到院内暗藏多重聚灵阵、迷幻阵、杀阵，寻常闲人靠近便会被阵法迷惑，根本察觉不到内里玄机。

踏入院内，几名身着749局制服的工作人员躬身行礼，态度恭敬。

“林队，各位道长、高人，一路辛苦。”一名负责人上前拱手，“分局早已备好住处与议事大厅，东北这边的最新情报也已整理完毕，等候各位查阅。”

林佳微微点头：“辛苦安排，先带各位安顿住处，半个时辰后议事大厅集合，商讨下一步探查计划。”

工作人员领命，领着众人分到东西跨院厢房，每人一间，清雅安静，灵气充足，适合调息休整。

胡九郎入房之后，关上房门，盘膝坐在木床之上。

一路列车奔波，又在黑风岭出手布阵、符箓困敌，虽不算重伤，却也耗损了少许灵气。他闭目调息，运转龙虎山正统道法，周身灵气缓缓流转，滋养经脉，恢复损耗。

心神沉静下来，脑海里又不由自主浮现杨童的身影。

若是她还在，此刻定然也会跟着一起北上，并肩作战。只可惜红尘缘浅，生死两隔，徒留他一人执念红尘，孤身踏遍风雪。

Chapter 75: Settlement in Shengjing, Ma Xian comes to take over - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The special train went all the way north, passing through the hinterland of the plains. The further north it went, the cooler the temperature became.

The scenery outside the window changed from the lush green mountains in the south of the Yangtze River to the bleak wilderness in the north. The autumn wind blew withered grass flying all over the sky. There was a biting chill in the air, and even the sunlight seemed dim and weak.

After thirty-six hours of galloping day and night, the train finally entered the territory of Shengjing in Northeast China.

Shengjing, Shenyang.

As an important town in the Northeast, the Northern Branch of Bureau 749 is secretly located here, controlling all supernatural events outside the customs, controlling superpowers, and suppressing evil spirits.

The special train enters a secret underground platform, which is not open to the public and does not connect with civilian railways. It operates covertly throughout the journey to prevent outside prying eyes.

The train came to a slow stop and the doors opened.

The eight-person team got out of the car one after another. At their feet was a spacious and deep underground passage. The walls were inlaid with hidden night lights and the light was soft. Multiple warning formations and spiritual energy shielding restrictions were placed on both sides of the passage. The security was extremely tight.

"This is the underground hub of the 749 Bureau in Shengjing." Lin Jia introduced as he walked, "From here to the hidden office area above the ground, it looks like an ordinary old-fashioned compound to the outside world, but in fact it is the core stronghold of the Northern Branch."

Everyone followed Lin Jia through the long passage and out of the ground.

What comes into view is a quaint old-fashioned courtyard house with blue bricks and gray tiles, tall walls, and towering ancient trees. It looks the same as an ordinary house in the old city, without any ostentation of a special department.

But with a sweep of their consciousness, everyone could notice that there were multiple spirit-gathering arrays, psychedelic arrays, and killing arrays hidden in the courtyard. Ordinary people who approached would be confused by the arrays and would not be able to detect the mystery inside.

Upon entering the hospital, several staff members wearing uniforms from the 749th Bureau bowed and saluted respectfully.

"Team Lin, all Taoist priests and experts, you have worked hard all the way." A person in charge stepped forward and handed over his hands. "The branch office has already prepared the residence and meeting hall. The latest information from the Northeast has also been compiled and is waiting for your review."

Lin Jia nodded slightly: "I have worked hard to arrange for you to settle down in your accommodation first. We will gather in the meeting hall in half an hour to discuss the next exploration plan."

The staff took the order and led everyone to separate rooms across the east and west courtyards. Each person had a room, which was elegant, quiet, and full of spiritual energy, suitable for rest and relaxation.

After Hu Jiulang entered the room, he closed the door and sat cross-legged on the wooden bed.

After traveling all the way, he set up formations in Black Wind Ridge and trapped the enemy with talismans. Although he was not seriously injured, he also lost a little spiritual energy.He closed his eyes and adjusted his breath, using the orthodox Taoist methods of Longhu Mountain. The spiritual energy throughout his body slowly circulated, nourishing his meridians and restoring their depletion.

After his mind calmed down, Yang Tong's figure involuntarily appeared in his mind.

If she were still here, she would definitely follow him northward and fight side by side.It's a pity that the world of mortals is so shallow and separated between life and death, leaving him alone to cling to the world of mortals and walk through the wind and snow alone.
